contexts.text: Under Delight, see this reference.
I perceived from the dullness... that Societies of such Spirits were present. AC 4804.
In the world, the sensation is dulled and obscured.
By sensuous things... (this light) grows dull...
(The Spirits of the bones) are slow, dull, stupid...
They who relate to the gross mucus of the brain (are the cause of) dulnesses. SE 1793.
The eye of man is so dull and gross... AC 9577:2.
The more imperfect things, which succeed by degrees, cause dullness.
Thus the shameful and filthy things of Spirits and Genii are blunted with the Angels.
Clever in the things of the world, but dimmed and dulled in the things of Heaven.
The light of my eyes began to be dulled, and to become dim.

They became water-serpents = that they became dull as to the apperception of truth. Water-serpents = falsities from fallacies; here, dullness as to the apperception of truth; for, as fallacies cause truths not to be apperceived, so, also, is dullness induced. Such a dullness is also induced by the magicians in the other life, and this by the abuse and perversion of order; for they know how to take away the influx from Heaven, (and thus produce) dullness as to the apperception of truth... They also know how to inject what is persuasive, and thus to dull the apperception of truth... When there is dullness, falsities appear as truths...
The glowing and sparkling of the Sun... began to grow dull.
Dulled by the cares of the world...
Evils and falsities not only blunt, but also reject His Divine influx.
The sensuous man... is so dull in the power of seeing truth, that it is scarcely possible to be duller.
The body absorbs and blunts these things.

A certain one... was so dull and as it were stupid, that he scarcely knew anything that was said. His dullness was communicated to me... It so obscured my thoughts, that I scarcely perceived what I was writing. In the life of the body he had been preeminently clever, but only in externals...
They were so poisonous, that they dulled all the forces of acting in truths and goods...

When (this preacher) was present, and the persuasion of his life flowed in, these (Knowledges) were so dulled, that they who were around me could scarcely apprehend the sense of the words... so completely was everything closed, bedimmed, and dulled, merely by the life of his persuasion.
The fathers have eaten a wild grape, and the teeth of the sons are dulled (). The teeth to be dulled = to be in the falsity of evil therefrom... To be dulled = the appropriation of falsity from evil.
The signs of the presence (of hypocrites in the Societies), are... deprivation of the perception of good, dulling of the affection of truth...
